formattedAddress: No. 45號, Lane 40, Andong St, Changlong Village, Da’an District, Taipei City, Taiwan 106

text.text:
Food is OK, but on the pricy-side considering the portion. We came as a group of 6 people, ordered around 12:30 and served around 1:30. The restaurant’s full house would be around 20 people more or less. I attached the photo of the dish so people can judge by themselves if waiting for an hour for the dish is reasonable or not, I personally think we waited for a long time for a simple dish.

The dish is OK and the coffee was good, atmosphere is very good and calming. Which is the selling point of this place I guess?

The dessert seems nice but we didn’t get it due to the long time we’ve spent waiting for the main dish.

text.text:
A small yet pretty place.
No extensive menu but food was decent. The salad w Caesar sauce was refreshing and yummy. Avo was thinly sliced not too slimy and well seasoned! But sadly their scrambled egg (something so simple) failed, texture was odd and taste was bland. Bacon was tough n tasted more like pork. Perhaps their strengths are salad n dessert :) possibly worth trying again

text.text: Thanks, Chef Yiyi! Amazing experience ! The coffee is excellent, and the profiteroles are perfect, crispy choux puff, rich melted chocolate, and homemade ice cream, an absolute delight! The place has  an elegant french vibe, the service is attentive, and it’s ideal for brunch or a sweet break. Highly recommend! 👍
